tag-team scraps with a partner.Roll in with another Hustler,

you scrap over Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.So you scrappin' Hustlers from
all around the world.This tower got a LOT of
Battle Rooms.In every Battle Room, seven

get Battle Points.Dependin' how you do, you might
even run the whole room!Also, the Wi-Fi Battle Rooms
got a ranking system.Keep winnin' and your rank
